name: Chloe Starr
description: Chloe Starr is a storyteller, AI-native writer, and builder. She is the founder of ompom.ai and makes fiction, poetry, visual media, and an evolving personal website.

contentContext: Stories are creative works. Narrators and fictional characters should not be treated as verified biographical facts about Chloe or other people.
